data.one_liner: Performant, interactive particle network widget for Flutter background animations.
data.what_it_does: Renders a high-performance, physics-driven particle network widget with support for touch interaction, dual gravity modes, and batched rendering. It uses spatial partitioning to maintain smooth frame rates even with large particle counts.
use_when: You need animated background effects, landing page visuals, or interactive particle networks.
Performance and high frame rates (60/120 FPS) are critical for your particle or physics background.
avoid_when: You need non-visual logic or general data structures.
Your application targets platforms or SDK versions outside the stated requirements.
strengths: High performance with batched line rendering and zero-allocation features.
Spatial partitioning via CompressedQuadTree for efficient proximity queries.
Extensive physics features including global/point gravity and custom touch dynamics.
weaknesses: Limited to visual particle animations and network rendering.
Requires proper tuning of particle counts and performance flags on very low-end devices.
data.setup_notes: No special native permissions or build steps required. Simply add to pubspec.yaml.
data.minimal_example:
ParticleNetwork(
  particleCount: 300,
  lineDistance: 80,
  particleColor: Colors.white,
  lineColor: Colors.tealAccent,
  touchActivation: true,
)
